verdict.rationale: Decagon explicitly offers a Voice product built for natural, multilingual conversations, and its platform architecture (shared AOPs, integrations, knowledge base) implies the same underlying logic/actions power chat and voice. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms voice shares identical knowledge/actions/AOPs as chat, nor gives hands-on proof of call quality or feature parity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent evidence that voice and chat share the same knowledge base and action set, real-world call transcripts/case studies validating voice parity, and detail on latency/interruption handling for phone use.
